metadata.title: आदिवासी पहचान पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट का आदेश | हेमंत सोरेन को क्यों जेल | Adivasi News in Hindi
metadata.description: In this week's bulletin, A ray of hope emerges following a Supreme Court decision, aiming to erase the long-standing stigma on tribal communities labeled as criminals. Then we take you to Gadchiroli, where a tribal woman was burnt alive due to the practice of witchcraft. Later, we'll discuss what the Supreme Court stated regarding the bail plea of former Jharkhand CM Hemant Soren. Stay tuned as we delve into the electoral atmosphere of Jharkhand.
